title: Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Appendix] Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 28) 1. General Criteria (a) The aggravated criteria for imposing administrative fines according to the number of violations shall apply where an administrative fine has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding three years. The period shall be calculated by reference to the date on which the administrative fine was imposed for the violation and the date on which another instance of the same violation committed after that disposition was detected. (b) Where an aggravated disposition is imposed under item (a), the degree of aggravation applied shall be the degree immediately following that of the disposition imposed before the violation concerned (where two or more administrative fines were imposed during the period under item (a), the highest degree among those dispositions). (c) The imposing authority may reduce the administrative fine prescribed in the individual criteria in subparagraph 2 by up to one half in any of the following cases: Provided, That this shall not apply to an offender who is in arrears in paying an administrative fine: 1) Where the violation is recognized as resulting from minor carelessness or an error; 2) Where the nature and degree of the violation are minor and the resulting harm is recognized as small; 3) Where the offender is recognized as having made efforts to rectify or eliminate the state of noncompliance with the Act; 4) Where a reduction is otherwise considered necessary in light of the degree of the violation, its motive, its consequences, and other circumstances. (d) The imposing authority may increase the administrative fine prescribed in the individual criteria in subparagraph 2 by up to one half in any of the following cases: Provided, That even an increased fine shall not exceed the maximum administrative fine under Article 25 (1) or (2) of the Act: 1) Where the violation is recognized as intentional or as resulting from gross negligence; 2) Where the nature and degree of the violation are serious and the resulting harm is recognized as substantial; 3) Where an increase is otherwise considered necessary in light of the degree of the violation, its motive, its consequences, and other circumstances. 2. Individual Criteria (a) Administrative fines under Article 25 (1) of the Act
ViolationStatutory basisAdministrative fine
First violationSecond violationThird or subsequent violation
Where a person sells petroleum products that were exempted from traffic, energy and environment tax for use by foreign-going vessels or deep-sea fishing vessels under Article 15 (1) 3 of the Act but were released for purposes other than use by such vessels, or acquires those products with knowledge of that fact, and falls under either of the following cases:
1) The sales value or acquisition value does not exceed 100 million won.		Article 25 (1) of the ActAn amount equivalent to 50 percent of the sales value or acquisition valueAn amount equivalent to 200 percent of the sales value or acquisition valueAn amount equivalent to 300 percent of the sales value or acquisition value
2) The sales value or acquisition value exceeds 100 million won.The sales value or acquisition value minus 50 million wonAn amount equivalent to 200 percent of the sales value or acquisition valueAn amount equivalent to 300 percent of the sales value or acquisition value
(b) Administrative fines under Article 25 (2) of the Act
ViolationStatutory basisAdministrative fine (unit: 10,000 won)
Where a person violates an order for securing tax collection under Article 21 of the Act and falls under any of the following cases:
1) Revenue for the immediately preceding business year is less than 5 billion won.		Article 25 (2) of the Act300
2) Revenue for the immediately preceding business year is at least 5 billion won but less than 10 billion won.500
3) Revenue for the immediately preceding business year is at least 10 billion won.1,000
Notes In subparagraph 2 (b) of the tables above, “revenue” means the amount specified in each of the following categories: Provided, That where an amount has been determined or reassessed under Article 66 of the Corporate Tax Act or Article 80 of the Income Tax Act, it means that determined or reassessed amount; and where the period of the preceding year is less than one year due to the commencement of a new business, suspension of business, or a similar reason, only revenue during that period shall be regarded as revenue for the immediately preceding business year. 1. For a corporation: Revenue reported under Article 60 (1) of the Corporate Tax Act (including where that provision applies mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 97 (1) 2 of that Act). 2. For an individual: Gross income under Article 24 of the Income Tax Act (limited to amounts attributable to business income and reported under Articles 70, 70-2, 71, and 74 of that Act).

■ 교통ㆍ에너지ㆍ환경세법 시행령 [별표] <신설 2022. 2. 15.>                           


                                                                                        


  과태료의 부과기준(제28조 관련)                                                        


                                                                                        


  1. 일반기준                                                                           


    가. 위반행위의 횟수에 따른 과태료의 가중된 부과기준은 최근 3년간 같은 위반          


  행위로 과태료 부과처분을 받은 경우에 적용한다. 이 경우 기간의 계산은 위               


  반행위에 대하여 과태료 처분을 받은 날과 그 처분 후 다시 같은 위반행위를               


  하여 적발한 날을 기준으로 한다.                                                       


    나. 가목에 따라 가중된 부과처분을 하는 경우에는 가중처분의 적용 차수는 그           


  위반행위 전 부과처분 차수(가목에 따른 기간에 과태료 부과처분이 둘 이상                


  있었던 경우에는 높은 차수를 말한다)의 다음 차수로 한다.                               


    다. 부과권자는 다음의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우 제2호의 개별기준에 따른 과          


  태료의 2분의 1 범위에서 그 금액을 줄여 부과할 수 있다. 다만, 과태료를 체              


  납하고 있는 위반행위자에 대해서는 그렇지 않다.                                        


      1) 위반행위가 사소한 부주의나 오류로 인한 것으로 인정되는 경우                    


      2) 위반행위의 내용ㆍ정도가 경미하여 그 피해가 적다고 인정되는 경우                


      3) 위반행위자가 법 위반상태를 시정하거나 해소하기 위해 노력한 것이 인             


  정되는 경우                                                                           


      4) 그 밖에 위반행위의 정도, 위반행위의 동기와 그 결과 등을 고려하여 줄            


  일 필요가 있다고 인정되는 경우                                                        


    라. 부과권자는 다음의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 제2호의 개별기준에 따           


  른 과태료 금액의 2분의 1 범위에서 그 금액을 늘려 부과할 수 있다. 다만, 늘             


  려 부과하는 경우에도 법 제25조제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 과태료의 상한을                 


  넘을 수 없다.                                                                         


      1) 위반행위가 고의나 중대한 과실에 따른 것으로 인정되는 경우                      


      2) 위반행위의 내용ㆍ정도가 중대하여 그 피해가 크다고 인정되는 경우                


      3) 그 밖에 위반행위의 정도, 위반행위의 동기와 그 결과 등을 고려하여 늘            


  릴 필요가 있다고 인정되는 경우

  비고                                                                                  


  위 표 제2호나목에서 “수입금액”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 금액을 말한다.          


  다만, 「법인세법」 제66조 또는 「소득세법」 제80조에 따라 결정ㆍ경정된 금액

visual_reconciliation_overlay.translated_annotation: Both original GIF pages form one continuous Appendix. The administrative-fine heading spans three violation-frequency columns, and the common statutory-basis cells span the two value bands in table 2 (a) and the three revenue bands in table 2 (b). The 100-million-won threshold is inclusive only in the first band. Above that threshold, the first fine is the value minus 50 million won. Table 2 (b) retains the source unit of 10,000 won and the amounts 300, 500, and 1,000. Blank padding and the page break create no additional substantive rows.

verified_source_observation.blank_cell_policy: No applicant input rows or standalone blank substantive entries. Blank vertical space and merged-cell padding do not create additional rows. The two-page split is a display break within table 2.a.
verified_source_observation.full_text_content_status: All substantive prose, references and numeric cells in the two images are represented in the frozen XML full_text; the overlay preserves continuous table structure and merged headings.

general_criteria.a: 최근 3년간 같은 위반행위 과태료 부과처분이 있는 경우 가중. 기간은 앞선 과태료 처분일과 처분 후 같은 위반행위를 하여 적발한 날을 기준으로 계산한다.
general_criteria.b: 직전 적용 차수의 다음 차수를 적용하며, 기간 내 둘 이상 처분이면 가장 높은 차수의 다음 차수를 적용한다.

notes.corporation: 법인세법 제60조제1항 신고 수입금액. 제97조제1항제2호에 따른 준용 포함.
notes.individual: 소득세법 제24조 총수입금액 중 제70조ㆍ제70조의2ㆍ제71조ㆍ제74조 신고 사업소득 금액만.
notes.lead: 제2호나목의 수입금액은 구분별 금액. 법인세법 제66조 또는 소득세법 제80조 결정ㆍ경정 금액이 있으면 그 금액. 신규 사업개시ㆍ휴업 등으로 직전연도가 1년 미만이면 해당 기간 수입금액만 인정.
